rationale: Review started 2026-11-10T06:54:52Z and ended 2026-11-10T07:05:36Z (UTC). I re-hashed jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11726.txt and EO_11775.txt (both match, as do all 16 source fingerprints), confirmed the spans, and read EO 11726 (38 FR 17711, signed June 29, 1973) in full, confirming identity: Sec. 1 establishes the Energy Policy Office, Sec. 2 sets the Director's functions, Sec. 3 support, Sec. 4 a report by March 15, 1974 (a report deadline is never an end), and Sec. 5 supersedes EO 11712 and abolishes the Special Committee on Energy and the National Energy Office, performed on signing. EO 11748 Sec. 6 (December 4, 1973) supersedes EO 11726 only 'to the extent that it is inconsistent with this Order', and EO 11775 itself records that the Office 'was continued in being on an interim basis' and in Sec. 2(c) still transfers functions from its Director, so EO 11748 was not a whole-order end; the producer's resolution of PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLAUSE_CHECK is correct. EO 11775 Sec. 1 (signed March 26, 1974, 39 FR 11415) states 'The Energy Policy Office is hereby abolished and Executive Order No. 11726 of June 29, 1973, is hereby superseded', unqualified and reaching the whole order, and the held 15 U.S.C. 761 note independently records the same supersession. A cruden number search found EO 11726 cited only by EO 11748, EO 11775 and that U.S. Code note; the EO 12038 ACT lead is the note's wording rather than an action by EO 12038, the dossier has no current-law lead, and I found no revival. The recommended status NO is supported by held sources through 2026-10-14.
